notes.title: Version 0.3.7 with MUSIC and other features
notes.content:
We just released an updated version that is largely about improved audio. Most importantly adding music completely changes the experience. Another important update is an experimental thrust capability that allows you to get away fast when an alien encounter becomes too much. Please let us know what you think about this thrust capability.
Here is a summarized list of the changes.

    Music throughout
    Improved sound effects
    Updated audio scripts
    Thrust for those times when you want to get away fast
    Updated to Unity 5.5
    New achievements

notes.title: New advanced level and additional changes for Release 0.3.5
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27177605/19aab5cd7e61901e78b3ec23f32df2fc74771463.png

We just added a new map we are quite proud of (see screenshot above). This is our most advanced level that is an abandoned nuclear complex.
WARNING: This is extremely difficult, if not impossible level to complete.

In addition, version 0.3.5 includes the following updates:

    Rumble--literally feel the impact of getting shot!
    Pause menu with option to restart the scene, go back to the mainmenu scene, or change settings.
    Settings screen that provides options to turn off rumble, rotation speed, and dynamic rest frames for those that are immune to motion sickness.
Lots of miscellaneous tweaks.

notes.title: Version 0.3.4 released
notes.content:
We now have another build! Most importantly leaderboards are now showing at the end of each level. Otherwise the time the level was completed doesn't mean a whole lot if you can't compare your score to the scores of others. Here is a simplified list of this version's changes.

Minor alien variation
Improved dynamic rest frame 
Leaderboard improvement
Art improvements
